# Model Overview (for Diagnosis)
The probe targets one fitted HSTU model per category. Through ModelView, `item_emb(ids)` exposes effective item embeddings, `log2feats(sequence)` returns causal features shaped B × L × hidden, and `predict_score(features, items)` scores items. History interventions read the feature at the greatest nonpadding index, correctly handling left padding. The backbone implementation is not supplied; its internal layers cannot be assessed here.

# Diagnosis Inputs & Hooks
`DiagnosisProbe(view, device)` accesses the actual module through `view.model`, training histories through `view.user_train['History']`, and optional metadata interfaces. Loader batches contain `(None, sequence, positive, negative)` with matching B × L tensors. IDs, dimensions and scoring shapes are checked. `run_full_diagnosis` caches up to ten batches, temporarily enables evaluation/inference mode, and restores module modes and captured random-generator states afterward.

# Probes & Metrics
- **Embedding alignment:** Samples up to 2,048 items and maps mean off-diagonal cosine to [0,1]. Approximately 0.5 means zero mean cosine; values near 1 indicate strong alignment, but do not establish representation rank or recommendation diversity.
- **Training-pair separation:** Reports mean and tenth-percentile positive-minus-negative margins, negative-win rate, and margins below 0.5. Larger margins and fewer negative wins indicate stronger sampled-pair separation; the 0.5 threshold depends on score scale.
- **History sensitivity:** Measures target rank, reciprocal rank and hit@10 on training prefixes. Positive perturbed-minus-original rank changes mean deterioration; positive reciprocal-rank/hit changes mean improvement.
- **Cost:** Records wall time, CUDA interval, peak allocated memory and scoring counts.

# Perturbation & Tests
Up to 32 identified users contribute two eligible prefixes each; loader rows provide a fallback. Each prefix shares one target and up to 999 unique negatives across original, recent/oldest deletions, final-item deletion, prefinal deletion and three nonfinal shuffles. Deletions compact histories and restore left padding. Effects average within users; 2,000 user-cluster bootstrap replicates provide conditional intervals when possible.

# MODEL_DIAGNOSIS Schema & Limitations
Raw output contains `metrics` and `metric_definitions`, including margins, embedding alignment, category breakdown, nested `history_interventions` and cost. Missing quantities are null with reasons. The interpreter requests JSON containing `status`, `core_findings`, `key_implications` and `evidence`.

These are frozen-checkpoint training diagnostics, not host validation results. Item-category breakdowns and four-category macro estimates are unavailable. The probes cannot establish generalization, intent, elapsed-time effects, diversity or conformity; intervals exclude training uncertainty.
